characters.name: Ролло Бульк
characters.concept: A comically round turquoise seal with a broad squishy whiskered muzzle, tiny black eyes with cheeky brows, stubby flippers and short tail. Its oversized horizontal orange foam paint roller forms the lower part of its belly, integrated into two curved side brackets, so it waddles while rolling a stripe of orange paint. The seal is NOT a shark, has no shoes or human legs. Wet satin seal skin, subtly porous roller, warm orange paint on lower roller. A small fresh curved paint streak directly beneath the roller conveys its role without obscuring it. Broad original silhouette with the seal visibly sitting over its own belly roller.

characters.name: Пельмолёт
characters.concept: A lively flying dumpling character: the whole main fuselage is one plump crescent-shaped ivory dumpling with finely pinched dough pleats along its arched spine, expressive wide eyes in the dough face and a delighted small mouth. A small clear glass pot-lid cockpit is embedded on top, not a head dome over an animal. Two chunky brushed-steel dining forks project sideways as playful wings, their four tines clearly visible. Three small paint-filled dumplings hang beneath its body, with bright magenta, cyan and orange paint tips, obviously soft harmless cartoon paint pods. Short dough landing feet, subtle flour dust in creases, beautiful soft dough material. No reptile, no realistic military aircraft, no weapon decals. Slightly hovering with a small contact shadow.

characters.name: Моржо-Морожо
characters.concept: An eccentric stocky mint-blue walrus ice-cream cart creature: rounded walrus head, broad folded muzzle with stout white whiskers, cheerful small eyes, two thick ivory ice-pop-stick-shaped tusks with rounded ends. Its enormous pale-golden waffle-textured belly is an integrated softly rounded ice-cream-cart torso, with two small plum-purple wheels at the sides and walrus flippers used as arms. A swirl of strawberry-pink soft serve rises behind its head like a soft messy cowlick. The animal and cart are a single coherent creature, not a normal walrus sitting in a separate vehicle. Waffle diamond pores, velvety skin, soft frost and creamy materials. No refrigerator, no camel, no boots.

characters.name: Утюгонос
characters.concept: A squat friendly teal platypus with a perfectly integrated broad coral-red clothes-iron-shaped bill: bill has a smooth triangular rounded metal sole under it and a soft red arched upper surface, with a few small steam holes; still reads as its own long flat bill rather than holding an iron. Bright curious eyes, small rounded forepaws and big webbed hind feet. Its flat paddle tail continues into a thick coiled electric cord ending in a chunky unplugged two-prong plug resting behind the creature. Subtle wisps of harmless steam from bill, not covering the face. Soft short teal fur, warm ivory belly, brushed metal bill sole. Funny determined waddling pose. No weapons, no aircraft, no goose.

characters.name: Макароника
characters.concept: A charming lavender-and-coral pasta octopus dancer. Its bulbous head and exactly eight thick flexible macaroni tentacles are made of smooth warm-golden pasta with tiny semolina speckles and clearly hollow tube openings at the tips; arrange all eight as a readable playful dance silhouette, not a tangled heap. Big lively eyes and a cheeky smile on the round pasta mantle. A small tilted turquoise metal colander is worn as a hat, with visible drain perforations and two little handles. Tentacle tips tinted with tiny pink and cyan paint smears. No cup head, no ballerina tutu, no humanoid torso or human legs. Organic lively bent pasta shapes, no thin noodles.

characters.name: Шуршун Пакетыч
characters.concept: An inflated animated kraft-paper shopping bag as a sneaky comic creature. The inflated bag body is softly pillow-shaped and creased, not a rigid rectangular box. Two bent paper loop handles form floppy expressive ears. A mischievous pair of large indigo oval eyes and a tiny folded-paper grin are integrated into the front. Rolled paper forearms and two folded paper gusset feet make a low tiptoeing pose. The side seam is partly concertina-folded to suggest it can flatten itself, while body stays recognizably inflated. Warm ochre paper fibers, rich fold shadows, a little teal paint on one foot. No ninja mask, no headband, no swords, no beverage cup, no logo or printed packaging.

characters.name: Брокко-Бокс
characters.concept: An exuberant broccoli boxer creature. Its head is a broad rounded rich-green broccoli crown, hundreds of tightly grouped small floret buds forming a coherent sculpted mass, with expressive brows, friendly narrowed eyes and grin nestled in the thick pale-green stalk face. A compact thick stalk body, two bent sturdy stalk arms ending in huge ivory cauliflower-floret fists, integrated as organic hands rather than conventional leather boxing gloves. Two short branching root feet with three blunt root toes each. Lively balanced sparring pose with one fist forward, both feet visible. Velvety botanical texture, pale stem fibers, a few tiny pink paint flecks. No monkey features, no long proboscis nose, no tree-person, no human feet.

characters.name: Будило-Бегемот
characters.concept: A hilariously sleepy chubby lavender hippopotamus with enormous rounded soft muzzle, drooping eyelids and one raised eyebrow. A large round cream-and-turquoise mechanical alarm clock is organically embedded in its pot belly; clock has chunky colorful hands and simple raised unnumbered hour dots, no letters or digits. Two shiny coral alarm bells sit by its small ears, attached with little rounded stems. Tiny chubby hippo arms and four-toed hippo feet, with a small wind-up key on its flank. One arm half raised as if startled awake by its own alarm. Smooth soft hippo skin with folds, polished clock glass and brass edge. No wooden log or bat, no human legs. The clock must not replace its head.

characters.name: Феник Фу-Фу
characters.concept: A living chunky teal hairdryer character with two short springy coral feet. Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual original playable character concept for a colorful mobile planet-painting game, preproduction art, not a game screenshot.
Style/medium: polished stylized 3D character render, rounded organic sculpted forms, expressive face, carefully resolved material detail, charming surreal comedy. Consistent high-end toy-like game art, not a collection of primitive blocks.
Scene/backdrop: very pale cyan seamless studio backdrop with a soft contact shadow only.
Composition/framing: square image, ONE character, full body including every foot/appendage visible, clean readable three-quarter front view, character fills about 78 percent of frame with comfortable margin. Anatomy and silhouette should remain understandable for a Blender modeler and at small mobile scale.
Lighting/mood: broad soft studio key light, gentle rim light, bright saturated character against pale background, cheerful and mischievous.
Constraints: develop the specific original concept described below; no existing meme character likeness, no brand marks, no recognizable franchise costume, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no border, no additional characters. No combat gore. No detached parts except appendages explicitly described.
Subject: A wonderfully absurd donut-bodied hippopotamus. Large friendly lilac hippo head with broad rounded muzzle and tiny rounded ears sits at the top of an upright golden baked doughnut torus torso. The hole through the CENTER OF ITS BELLY must be clearly open and visible, showing the pale studio background through it; do not fill or cover this hole. Lavender icing on the upper torus arch and a few oversized colorful sugar sprinkles. Two small thick hippo arms attached to the outer torus sides and two chunky hippo feet at the bottom, leaving the belly hole completely unobstructed. Comical proud chest-forward pose with face toward viewer, slight three-quarter angle shallow enough to preserve the central hole. Beautiful bread pores, satin hippo skin. No fish, no bear, no human legs.
Working character name (for context only, do not print): Бубликопотам
